title: Spike hit below 500 points wraps score to ~65,000 instead of clamping at 0
observed: After collecting the coin (score 100) and stepping onto spikes at (3,3), score becomes 65136 (wrapped negative value) and lives drop to 2.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so the score should be 0 after the hit.
